sections.content: How many people are "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors"?

43,010 people

were counted on the census as "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors organise and co-ordinate the activities and resources of halls of residence, hotels, hostels, caravan sites, holiday camps, holiday flats and chalets, and organise the domestic, catering, and entertainment facilities on passenger ships.

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 55 to 59 years. Of the whole working population 10.4% were aged 55 to 59 years. For people working as "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors", 12.8% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" included:

  • barristers and judges
  • road transport drivers (other)
  • personal assistants and other secretaries

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

A similar number of men and women had this job

Among people working as "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" there were a similar number of men and women (49.1% compared with 50.9%).

This means "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 49.1% and women made up 50.9% of "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" included:

  • travel agency managers and proprietors
  • database administrators and web content technicians
  • other researchers, unspecified discipline

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Men and women with this occupation had a similar age profile, as shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "hotel and accommodation managers and proprietors", 9.9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (70.8% compared with 29.2%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (64.3%) than self-employed (35.7%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South West. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Cornwall, this is in the same region of the South West.
